title: Calcium

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: A calcium blood test measures the amount of calcium in your blood. Calcium is an important mineral that your nerves, muscles, and heart need to work properly; most of the body's calcium is stored in bones and teeth.
context: A calcium blood test does not tell you how much calcium is in your bones. A result outside the normal range does not always mean a condition that needs treatment; your diet and certain medicines and supplements, such as vitamin D, can affect calcium levels.
aboveRange: Certain types of cancer, including cancer that spreads to bone
Bone conditions such as Paget's disease of bone
Taking too much vitamin D over a long time
belowRange: Low blood protein, which can come from liver conditions or poor nutrition
Too little calcium in the diet
Too little vitamin D or magnesium
Inflammation of the pancreas or a kidney condition
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
